title: Prove the ad hoc Done lifecycle and kept-record release at typed seams

intentCoverage.report:
**Caught.** The migrated deletion test detects removal of a different kept record’s session-run refs from the same Git repository.

The probe used `SEED-413#ad-hoc-done-lifecycle` at `cb801ee78199df7a151c37e8e35103a4fc3f556b`. The deletion case in `dashboard/backend-tests/review/kept-commits-release.spec.ts` stores a `leaving` record and a `staying` record with distinct runs and landings. It verifies both sets of pins before deleting `leaving` through `deleteRecord`.

In the detached scratch checkout, the only fault broadened the `removePins` prefix in `releaseSessionCommitRefs` at `dashboard/server/launchRecordPins.ts:142` from the record’s session prefix to the host’s session-commits prefix. The deletion succeeded and reached the post-delete ref comparison at `dashboard/backend-tests/review/kept-commits-release.spec.ts:146`. Its actual `git for-each-ref` result contained the branch and the staying record’s two landing refs. The expected list also contained `refs/open-dough/session-commits/claude/staying/0/base` and `revision`. The assertion caught both missing refs. The expiry case caught the same fault through the shared helper.

All three trials used `caffeinate -s -i env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES npm run --silent test:dashboard:backend -- review/kept-commits-release.spec.ts --workers=2`. The baseline passed all four tests. The fault produced the two pin-preservation assertion failures and passed both missing-repository cases. The original bytes and clean Git state were verified after restoration, all four tests passed again, and the scratch worktree was removed.

**Next proof action.** Keep the existing deletion assertion. This check requires no additional proof or repair.

Run logs and the fault diff are retained in `/private/tmp/dough-731-coverage.XdYaC8i3`. Exact report saved at `/private/tmp/dough-731-coverage.XdYaC8i3/intent-coverage-report.md`.

- **Test runtime.** 1.87 s baseline, 1.26 s faulted, and 1.25 s restored, measured from Vitest’s reported duration.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. No human effort was separately recorded for the probe.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable. No separate active-agent clock was recorded.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 99178 ms (measured), from 1795170432631 to 1795170531809 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.


Wrap-up disposition at `cb801ee78199df7a151c37e8e35103a4fc3f556b`. Caught. No follow-up.
